'''Joseph Mercado''' {{post-nominals|list=[[Royal Institution|FRIEdr]]}} ({{IPA|tl|mɚkado}}, born July 2, 1972) is a Filipino statistician, professor, businessperson and [[university administrator]] who served as [[Dean (education)|dean]] and vice president at the [[Polytechnic University of the Philippines]] from 2006 to 2018.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.pup.edu.ph/news/?go=U/c2oqQ50hM=|title=President De Guzman appoints three new VPs|last=Valila|first=Krupskaya|date=2016|website=Polytechnic University of the Philippines Official Website|access-date=April 20, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|last=Cruz|first=RG|date=August 27, 2015|title=PUP president gets higher pay than UP president|work=ABS-CBN News|url=https://www.abs-cbn.com/focus/08/26/15/pup-president-gets-higher-pay-president|access-date=April 7, 2020}}</ref>

Mercado has co-authored scientific publications involving [[pharmaceutical sciences]],<ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://innovareacademics.in/journals/index.php/ijpps/article/view/15210|title=Survival Analysis for the Risk of Developing Heart Attack|date=2016|journal=International Journal of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences|doi=10.22159/ijpps.2016v8s2.15210 |access-date=April 20, 2020 |last1=Urrutia |first1=Jackie D. |last2=Tampis |first2=Razzcelle L. |last3=Mercado |first3=Joseph |last4=m. Baygan |first4=Aaron Vito |volume=8 |issue=2 |page=6 |doi-access=free }}</ref> [[economic analysis]],<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/277306257|title=Mathematical Model for Estimating Income Tax Revenues in the Philippines through Regression Analysis Using Matrices|website=ResearchGate|access-date=April 20, 2020}}</ref> and [[Sociology|sociological analysis]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/280098112|title=Reading Attitudes of the Students of Polytechnic University of the Philippines: A Principal Component Factor Analysis|website=ResearchGate|access-date=April 20, 2020}}</ref> and received the Distinguished Research Award from the Academic International Consortium of Indonesia for his work in 2016.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Viray|first=Kriztine|title=VPREPD speaks at Asia Pacific Confab|work=Polytechnic University of the Philippines News|url=https://www.pup.edu.ph/news/?go=LrYbNIyQvVY%3d|access-date=June 25, 2020}}</ref> At present, Mercado is a member of the Philippine Statistical Association, the [[Department of Science and Technology (Philippines)|National Research Council of the Philippines]], and the Royal Institution, Singapore as a fellow.<ref name=":0" />

== Early life and education ==
Mercado finished a [[Bachelor of Applied Science|Bachelor of Applied Statistics]] degree in 1993, a [[Master of Applied Science]] degree in 2000 and a [[Doctor of Education|Doctor of Educational Management]] degree in 2003, all at the [[Polytechnic University of the Philippines]] (PUP).<ref name=":0" />

In 2011, Mercado completed a Criminology PhD at the [[Philippine College of Criminology]]. After becoming a university vice president, he attended an Executive Development Program held by the [[Commission on Higher Education (Philippines)|Commission on Higher Education (CHED)]] with other university administrators to further his knowledge on higher education management.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ched.gov.ph/blog/2017/07/20/ched-launches-second-batch-executive-development-program-philhecs/|title=CHED Launches the Second Batch of the Executive Development Program of the PhilHECS|date=July 20, 2017|website=Commission on Higher Education (CHED)|access-date=April 20, 2020}}</ref>

== Career ==
=== Polytechnic University of the Philippines (2005–2018) ===
In 2004, Mercado first sat as the acting director of [[Polytechnic University of the Philippines Ragay|PUP Ragay]]. Consequently, in 2006, he was appointed as the director of [[Polytechnic University of the Philippines Santo Tomas|PUP Sto. Tomas Batangas branch]] and then designated as the dean of the College of Science. At the same time, he was also the assistant director of the Center for Data and Statistical Analysis. Three years later, he became the executive director for branches and campuses. After a short five-month stint as executive director, Mercado then served as the vice president for branches and campuses for three years. In late 2015, Mercado was then appointed by [[Emanuel de Guzman]], the university's [[President of the Polytechnic University of the Philippines|president]], to be the vice president for research, extension, planning and development.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite news|last=Dalac|first=Dan Esponilla|date=June 2014|title=Administration Okays P1.7M Grant for 11 Researches|work=Polytechnic University of the Philippines News|url=https://www.pup.edu.ph/news/?go=VR5rN0%2bcsgg%3d|access-date=June 25, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|last=Viray|first=Joseph Reylan|title=PUP inks MOU with Burapha University|work=Polytechnic University of the Philippines News|url=https://www.pup.edu.ph/news/?go=lgfDkyDT%2bdQ%3d|access-date=June 25, 2020}}</ref> To pursue personal endeavors, Mercado resigned from office in mid-2018. However, he still serves as an expert advisor to the university, specializing in applied statistics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.pup.edu.ph/media/experts|title=Directory of Experts|website=PUP Official Website|access-date=April 22, 2020}}</ref>

== Notable works ==
=== Scientific publications ===
Mercado has authored and co-authored several [[scientific publication]]s that have been recognized in national and international [[Scientific journal|journals]].<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3" />

Among them are, but not limited to; "Mathematical Model for Estimating Income Tax Revenues in the Philippines through Regression Analysis using Matrices"<ref name=":1" /> "Predicting Spousal Physical Violence in the Philippines: a Binary Logistic Regression Analysis” for the [[European Academic and Research Network]];<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/280098385|title=Analysis on Predicting Spousal Physical Violence in the Philippines Using Binary Logistic Regression|website=ResearchGate|access-date=April 20, 2020}}</ref> and “Modeling the Philippines Real Gross Domestic Product: A Normal Estimation Equation For Multiple Linear Regression” for the [[American Institute of Physics]]’ Journal.<ref name=":3">{{Cite journal|url=https://aip.scitation.org/doi/10.1063/1.4940848|title=Modeling the Philippines' real gross domestic product: A normal estimation equation for multiple linear regression|journal=Enhancing the Role of Mathematics in Interdisciplinary Research|series=AIP Conference Proceedings |year=2016 |doi=10.1063/1.4940848 |access-date=April 20, 2020|last1=Urrutia |first1=Jackie D. |last2=Tampis |first2=Razzcelle L. |last3=Mercado |first3=Joseph |last4=Baygan |first4=Aaron Vito M. |last5=Baccay |first5=Edcon B. |volume=1707 |issue=1 |page=050016 |bibcode=2016AIPC.1707e0016U |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
